content.title: Could traffic jams be your best investment for your Akhirah?
content.subtitle: The story of a cyclist brother that could change your daily commute.
content.body:
Dhaka’s streets mean heavy traffic, endless honking, and exhausting rush hours. Every day, one of our brothers cycles through this chaos to reach his destination. Yet, despite the noise, dust, and frustration around him, his face carries a remarkable sense of calm. It seems the city's chaos cannot disturb his inner peace.

A Loving Dhikr with Every Pedal

What is the secret behind his calmness in such a restless city? As he cycles, he recites Durood upon the beloved Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. In his words: "When I recite Durood while cycling, my mind stays calm despite all the honking and heavy traffic. I don't lose my temper easily, and it becomes easier to stay patient. Along with exercising, I can also spend this tiring time in a beautiful act of worship."

This habit began with the Muslims Day campaign to recite Durood 10 million times. The app’s Durood Reminder feature has helped him maintain this practice despite his busy schedule.

Be Close to the Beloved Prophet ﷺ on the Hardest Day

Think about how much time we spend feeling frustrated while stuck in traffic or waiting for someone. Why not fill these moments, whether we are cycling, riding a bus, or waiting for someone, with Durood? The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said that whoever sends Durood upon him once, Allah sends ten blessings upon that person and forgives ten sins. (Sunan an-Nasa'i: 1297)

In another Hadith, he ﷺ said: "The closest people to me on the Day of Judgment will be those who send Durood upon me most often." (Jami' at-Tirmidhi: 484)

Imagine the Day when the sun will be unbearably close, and people will suffer from extreme thirst. Wouldn't we want to be among those closest to the greatest human being, whose intercession we hope for on that Day? Perhaps the most frustrating moments of your day could become your greatest opportunity to earn this honour.

Our Small Effort to Support Your Good Deeds

That is why we introduced the Durood Reminder feature in Muslims Day. However, since this feature is currently part of Premium, some users may wonder: Why keep such a beneficial feature behind a subscription? Wouldn't it be better if everyone could use it for free?

Honestly, we wish the same. We sincerely want every Muslims Day user to become a better Muslim today than yesterday and grow in love for the Prophet ﷺ. But keeping the app running requires significant expenses for servers, technical infrastructure, and uninterrupted service. We also have financial limitations to manage. That is why we have had to include this feature in our Premium plan.

Still, we have kept the price affordable for everyone at just BDT 100. That may be less than what we spend on a small daily snack. In return, you will receive 48 to 96 Durood reminders every day, and more than 2500 reminders a month!
